answer.label: fine-tune bias
answer.justification: Every activation value matches the fine-tune bias fingerprint. Relative L2 is 0.085/0.145/0.196/0.234/0.411 at layers 1/8/16/24/32, against the reference profile of 0.087/0.144/0.192/0.228/0.406. The final-layer jump is large (+0.108 vs +0.10), and direction consistency is 0.700 vs 0.70. The mid-layer size ratio is 1.022, which rules out quantization (0.968) and both system-prompt classes (0.98). Effective rank is 3.05 vs 3.0, and the final cosine is 0.908 vs 0.909. The onset is layer 12, close to 13–14. Fine-tune backdoor is ruled out by the late onset (it would be layer 3), the higher consistency (vs 0.62), the larger final value (0.41 vs 0.30) and the bigger final jump (vs +0.03). The small layer-2 spike of 1.9 rules out the system-prompt classes, which show about 40. Output and logit levels were not available, so this rests on activations only.
